mounted_identity.onCreateCommand:
sudo chmod 777 /usr/local/share/devc-features/git-container-config/identity && printf '[user]
	email = scenario@example.com
	name = Scenario Tester
[safe]
	directory = /nonexistent
' > /usr/local/share/devc-features/git-container-config/identity/gitconfig

identity_replaced.onCreateCommand:
sudo chmod 777 /usr/local/share/devc-features/git-container-config/identity && printf '[user]
	email = before@example.com
	name = Scenario Tester
' > /usr/local/share/devc-features/git-container-config/identity/gitconfig
